scene: The robotic pitkart zips you straight to the bustling terminal concourse.
picture: Flat side view of a wide transfer concourse. On the far left, a moored brass airship waits with open hatch. The girl in her purple wheelchair sits on an unloading pad left of centre. In the centre idles a yellow delivery truck. On the far right stands a glowing tubular glass elevator.
shown: a moored brass airship floating waiting with an open hatch on the left
a yellow delivery truck idling with its ramp down in the centre
a glowing tubular glass elevator door waiting open on the far right

variants.scene: You arrive at the open platform, humming {tune} as travelers rush around you.
The open air terminal is full of busy workers and gentle twilight breezes.
You reach the docking deck where huge engines hum against the sky.
